note: Prices, queues and rules change often. Every 'observed' value below was read from the directory's own page on the 'checked' date. Run scripts/check_directories.py before quoting any price to the user, and say the date you read it.

directories.name: Product Hunt
directories.cost: free to post
directories.cost_source: help.producthunt.com 'How to post a product' (sign in, click Submit)
assets: thumbnail 240x240 square, GIF allowed, under 3 MB
rules: Post your own product so you control the launch (Product Hunt help center).
Save as draft if not ready, schedule the launch day.
Do not ask for upvotes; ask people to check it out and comment.
directories.verify: The site blocks headless browsers; confirm field limits in the submit form.

directories.name: Hacker News (Show HN)
directories.cost: free
rules: Title starts with 'Show HN:'.
Must be something people can try now, ideally without signup; no landing pages, sign-up pages or fundraisers.
Must be your own work and you must be around to discuss it.
Minor version bumps are not Show HNs.
Never ask friends to upvote or comment.

directories.name: BetaList
directories.cost: paid plans; the founder picks a plan and pays after reviewing the draft
assets: 1-5 screenshots, each under 3 MB, 10-5000 px per side, png/jpeg/gif/webp/avif
rules: website_url must be the product's own custom domain (no app-store, Product Hunt, Notion or free-subdomain page).
An agent can draft via the API but never pays or publishes; it hands the founder a claim link.
directories.automatable: draft only (official agent API); the founder claims, edits and pays
directories.verify: Field limits for pitch/description: read betalist.com/agent before drafting.

directories.name: There's An AI For That
directories.cost: observed $49 one-time review fee for the basic launch; higher tiers listed
rules: AI tools only.

directories.name: SaaSHub
directories.cost: free, with an approval queue
rules: List your competitors or the submission goes to the bottom of the queue.
Products on free subdomains (e.g. *.vercel.app) are not accepted.
The page asks AI agents to have the human submit it themselves: do not automate this one.

directories.name: Uneed
directories.cost: observed: free launch (date assigned at the back of the line); $14.99 for a slot in about 14 days; $39.99 to skip the line and pick the date
rules: Free launches need an upvote score of 10 to stay published and 20 for the do-follow backlink (per the pricing page).

directories.name: Fazier
directories.cost: observed: free (reviewed and listed within 30 days, needs a backlink to Fazier on your homepage or footer); paid one-time tiers shown at $29, $49 and $99 (struck-through $39 / $69 / $139)

directories.name: Dang.ai
directories.cost: observed: free with a crawlable backlink to dang.ai, 1 category, up to 4 weeks review; $49 for review in about 4 days without backlink; Pro $30 setup then $19/mo
rules: AI tools only.

directories.name: TopAI.tools
directories.cost: observed: $47 one-time, live within 48 h; $229 featured for 7 days; automatic refund if not accepted
rules: AI tools only; editorial review.

directories.name: Aitoolnet
directories.cost: observed: $9.9 one-time (no queue, listed within 24 h); $49.9 tier
rules: AI tools only; no newsletters or directories.
Search the site first so you don't submit a duplicate.

directories.name: Launching Next
directories.cost: observed: free; optional $99 upgrade to be considered within 1 business day

directories.name: TinyLaunch
directories.cost: observed: Standard launch free (queue; badge and backlink for top 3); Premium $39 per launch (skip the queue, guaranteed backlink)

directories.name: MicroLaunch
directories.cost: free launch; premium option offered (price not captured)
directories.verify: Read the premium price in the launch form.

directories.name: DevHunt
directories.cost: free weekly launches; paid promotion offered
rules: Developer tools only.
directories.verify: Check queue length in the submit form.

directories.name: Peerlist Launchpad
directories.cost: needs a Peerlist profile; launches run in weekly cohorts
directories.verify: Confirm launch rules after creating a profile.

directories.name: Indie Hackers
directories.cost: free (account needed)
rules: Write a build-in-public post (what you made, numbers you actually have, what you learned) rather than an ad.

directories.name: Twelve Tools
directories.cost: listing offered with a dofollow link (the site advertises 'DR83'); price not captured
directories.verify: Open 'Submit your Tool' and read the price.

directories.name: LaunchIgniter
directories.cost: launch listing with a backlink (the site advertises 'DR 75'); price not captured
directories.verify: Open 'Submit Your Product' and read the terms.

directories.name: Insidr.ai
directories.cost: submission form; added if approved (no price shown)
rules: AI tools only.

directories.name: OpenAlternative
directories.cost: login required to submit
rules: Open-source alternatives to proprietary software only: skip if your product is closed source.

directories.name: AlternativeTo
directories.cost: free (account needed)
directories.verify: The add-app path could not be confirmed on the check date; sign in and use the site's add/suggest application link.

directories.name: Claude Marketplaces
directories.cost: observed: free; optional $4 priority review (24 h or less)
rules: Takes a skill repo, an MCP server or a plugin marketplace repo; sign in with GitHub.
Ranked by installs, refreshed from GitHub daily.
directories.only_if: you ship Agent Skills, Claude plugins or MCP servers

directories.name: awesome-claude-skills (travisvn)
directories.cost: free (pull request)
rules: Read the repo's CONTRIBUTING rules first; one PR, one line, alphabetical where required.
directories.automatable: PR only after the user approves the exact diff

directories.name: Reddit r/SideProject
directories.cost: free (account needed)
rules: Read the subreddit rules in the sidebar before posting; they change.
Post a story (what, why, what you learned), answer every comment.

directories.name: V2EX 分享创造
directories.cost: free (account needed)
rules: Post in the 分享创造 (create) node, in Chinese, as the maker.
No repeated posts; reply to comments.
directories.verify: The site blocks headless browsers; read the node rules by hand.

directories.name: SideProjectors
directories.cost: free listing (account needed)
rules: A marketplace to showcase or sell side projects: list only if you are open to offers or want showcase traffic.
